plan.title: Material PR to split-award auction PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding for the case.
Enable eRFX project creation from the PR flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the required event title so the event can be published and found later.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial RFQ quote.
Verify Vendor A's RFQ quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's initial RFQ quote.
Verify Vendor B's RFQ quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ while retaining its quotes and participants.
Commit the auction's bidding schedule on the converted create screen.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid at 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid at 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid for the two auction bidders.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed auction.
Allocate 6 units to Vendor A.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor B.
Verify the split award and total of 6×85 plus 4×88 equals 862.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Confirm the award proposal screen opened.
Submit the split-award proposal for approval.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approve split award for the material PR.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify POs were created with two awarded PO lines in total.
Return to the events list to verify the final event state.
Open the History tab where the completed event should appear.
Verify this plan's event moved into History.
